partition: same four heavily reused obstacle-enabled track-1 TRAIN roads used by long-v2 training; not fresh or protected evaluation
source_selection: First completed episode-boundary checkpoint >=100k, committed before observing its outcome; no replacement by better-looking intermediate model
runtime: isolated Torch 2.1.0+cpu, raw unmodified environment, default H3 MPPI and actor-prior mean, two canonical repeats per road/mode
comparison_limits: Prior and MPPI share road/reset conditions, not identical states or action trajectories after their first action. MPPI achieved higher mean raw return/progress on all-roads aggregate and progress on all four per-road pairs, but had higher mean damage and zero finishes just like prior. Action latency is an internal CPU proxy, not official packaged-agent validation. The training collector's evolving-policy 14/87 post70k finishes are neither the final model's rate nor a matched comparator. All sixteen source-bound frozen-model episodes ended uncensored before the 2000-decision limit. Four repeatedly viewed road geometries cannot establish fresh-road generalization, 50% completion, model promotion, or official score.
decision: The original 100k raw-reward H3 default-MPPI baseline is operationally complete and showed within-TRAIN H3 reward-ranking improvement (100k 31/40 vs pilot 25/40), but its frozen prior and MPPI both finished 0/8 on reused full episodes. Do not call the algorithm intrinsically failed or increase horizon/MPPI samples together; inspect a separately frozen single-axis training-target damage-increment reward-shaping hypothesis next while preserving official raw environment and evaluation metrics. The historic fresh-grid allocation auditor is still BLOCKED, and no protected/official evaluation is authorized.
